SELECT cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/30 AS INT) AS month_bucket, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(yt*1.0/NULLIF(anglers,0)),3) AS ypa, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/SUM(anglers),3) AS pooled_share
FROM trips
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT index_id, CAST(avail_doy/30 AS INT) AS month_bucket, AVG(value) AS avg_val
FROM climate
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
